query: I'm designing "KEP-5681: Conditional Authorization" in kubernetes/enhancements and I'm considering using "Propagate an API server-generated request UID to both authorization and admission". Was that approach already considered on this project, and if so, why wasn't it adopted?
response:
Yes, the approach **"Propagate an API server-generated request UID to both authorization and admission"** was considered in **`keps/sig-auth/5681-conditional-authorization/README.md`**.

It was not adopted because:
* Although it would have helped solve the atomicity concern, it is not a full long-term solution because it still relies on people setting up webhooks.
